trade_names: Tredegar Film Products; Tredegar Surface Protection; Bonnell Aluminum (out-of-build segment)
description_1line: SEGMENT build (films only): High Performance Films segment makes PE/PP surface-protection and advanced packaging films; the Aluminum Extrusions (Bonnell) segment is out of this build.
notes: Created 2026-10-30 in integration pass 16 from EDGAR step-2 packet L5 (manifest B12). CIK 0000850429. HQ leased at 1100 Boulders Parkway, Richmond, VA 23225 per FY2025 10-K Item 2 (county not asserted - Boulders campus straddles a county line in sources consulted). FY2025 10-K: two segments remain - Aluminum Extrusions and High Performance Films (renamed from PE Films in Q4 2025). Flexible Packaging Films (Terphane) was SOLD to Oben Group on 2024-11-01 and is discontinued operations - Terre Haute-class flexible-packaging plants are therefore no longer Tredegar (see S02). Item 2 lists Pottsville, PA as the sole US High Performance Films plant. Two held subsidiary-grain orgs already carry the Pottsville plant (ORG-002498 / ORG-002622 - a duplicate pair; see sites S01 and relationships.csv). No NAICS asserted for the parent. Tier basis (packet): A - SEC Form 10-K FY2025 Items 1+2 (CIK 0000850429)
